provenance.evidence_note: Capture-only: this entry pins the bytes of a driven capture and the observed signals that produced it. It is not an acceptance claim - the Red/Blue assertion half of #90.3 is deliberately deferred until the Yellow runtime half (PR #170) resolves, so this check has not been exercised by a committed RB test. The merged helper tests/test_battle_healing_items_rom.py::_evidence_fixture() selects its row by id - it filters the fixtures list on item['id'] - so no positional assumption on fixtures[0] is made or needed; this entry is appended after the existing one simply so the pre-existing entry's fields and index are unchanged. Red-color is NOT captured: the retained Pewter Red milestone (artifacts/vanilla-brock-red-direct-20260504/after_brock.state) is a single full-HP mon whose only two moves are damaging, so it cannot be damaged without risking a knockout of the Route 2 wild mon, and the one damaged Red milestone (walkthrough_red/milestones/cerulean_pc.state, 148/154) is in Cerulean and needs an entry route this producer does not have.
